key.name: animation
key.summary: How the highlight moves to the next item
key.description: slide moves it in one motion; stretch reaches out to the next item before letting go of the previous one; liquid flows like a drop, its head first and its tail after, with a thin neck between them; jelly springs past the item and wobbles back, stretching while fast; pop shrinks on the previous item and grows out of the next one; fade dims it out and back in on the next item; none jumps. The curve does not apply to liquid and jelly, which have their own motion.

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Length of the animation in milliseconds

key.name: animation-curve
key.description: smooth slows down at the end; overshoot goes past the item and springs back; bounce lands like a dropped ball; elastic swings around the item a few times; linear keeps the same speed.

key.name: curve-rebound
key.summary: Rebound of the overshoot, bounce and elastic curves
key.description: How far they go past the item, or how high they bounce, in percent. 50 is the usual amount.

key.name: stretch-reach
key.summary: Share of the stretch animation spent reaching over both items, in percent

key.name: liquid-viscosity
key.summary: How liquid the liquid style is
key.description: Higher values pull the head further ahead of the tail and make the tail and the neck between them thinner.

key.name: jelly-bounce
key.summary: How far the jelly springs past the item

key.name: jelly-wobbles
key.summary: How many times the jelly wobbles before it settles

key.name: jelly-stretch
key.summary: How much the jelly stretches while moving fast, in percent

key.name: pop-size
key.summary: How small the pop animation shrinks the highlight, in percent of the item

key.name: highlight-color
key.description: A color as #rrggbb. Empty uses the system accent color.

key.name: highlight-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the highlight's fill, in percent

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the highlight in pixels

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Width of the light border around the highlight in pixels
key.description: 0 draws no border. The outline that marks the app while its window thumbnails are open is always at least 2 pixels.

key.name: focus-scale
key.summary: Size of the selected item in percent
